Decipher.com Premiere card image for [[Millennium Falcon]]. It has the black border of Premiere Limited but prints the game text of [[Millennium Falcon (Unlimited)|Premiere Unlimited]] (April 1996), which added “Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.”; the printed Limited face is [[:File:Premiere-L-millenniumfalcon-hires.webp]].

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/images/millenniumfalcon.gif millenniumfalcon.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010809092436/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/images/millenniumfalcon.gif Internet Archive], 9 August 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: 172cf380e3b11dd3a2c392c0c5f545447340a7fd6137d8b2e6ae328ba4c45d56.

Edits: cropped to the black card border, and the corner pads outside the border set to white. The card face itself is unchanged.

The Holotable face used on the card page is [[:File:Premiere-L-millenniumfalcon.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
